# TechNext Asia

> AI-native technology company building enterprise AI and Odoo ERP solutions for global clients across Southeast Asia. Headquartered in Singapore with development hubs in Vietnam and the Philippines.

## About

TechNext Asia is an AI-native software company specializing in:
- Enterprise AI systems (agents, RAG pipelines, local LLMs, workflow automation)
- Odoo ERP implementation and customization for mid-market and enterprise clients
- Digital transformation consulting across Vietnam, Philippines, Singapore, and Germany

Founded to bring production-grade AI to businesses in Southeast Asia and globally. Clients span 10+ countries across manufacturing, logistics, professional services, and retail.

## Services

- **Enterprise AI**: Agentic AI, LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, AI workflow automation
- **Odoo ERP**: Full-cycle implementation, customization, migration, support
- **AI + ERP Integration**: Connecting AI capabilities directly into Odoo business processes
- **Local LLM Deployment**: On-premise AI for data-sensitive enterprise environments
